title: So BEAUTIFUL I  bought 3 more sets!
text: So BEAUTIFUL I  bought 3 more sets!. These curtains are exceptional...  I've been searching for a Mediterranean "look" for many months. The teal color is rich and perfect with my rust colored tiles. After receiving one set, I loved them so much I reordered 3 more sets for my sliders in bedrooms & dining room. Couldn't be happier with the fast delivery and 5 star quality fabric. A bonus to learn they are 100% polyester so will launder perfectly when necessary. I definitely recommend them & am so impressed with the manufacturer, I would buy other products from them without question. YES!!

product_metadata.title: MIUCO Moroccan Embroidery Semi Sheer Curtains Faux Linen Grommet Window Curtains for Living Room 52 x 63 Inch 2 Panels, Navy Blue
features: Sold as pair. Each panel measures 52 inch wide by 63 inch long. 8 metal grommets per panel with 1.6 inch inner diameter fit up to a 1.5" rod.
Miuco semi sheer curtains have a linen texture, allow natural light in while provide enough privacy than ordinary sheers.
Miuco embroidered Moroccan trellis design add style and elegance to your room, make a pretty soft and natural look to your windows.
Quality workmanship and beautiful embroidery on faux linen texture make your room have a more luxurious look.
Easy care, machine wash cold, gentle cycle, do not bleach, tumble dry low, light iron as needed.
description: Instantly update your home decor with Miuco floral embroidery semi sheer curtains. These beautifully woven faux linen curtain panels feature an all-over embroidered Moroccan trellis design, add style and elegance to any living space. Metal grommets enable easy open and close. The linen-look, chambray weaved texture reveals variations of color for an updated, modern feel. Perfect for bedroom, living room, dining room and den. These tonal embroidered curtains will compliment any decor. They are the ideal window treatments for your room. Each panel measures extra wide 52" x 63" long. Curtain pair offers a total width of 104" of window coverage. Fiber Content: 100% Polyester. Grommet size: 1.6 inch. Curtain panel can fit any rod up to 1.5" inch. Grommet color: Brushed Nickel (ORB), amazing color, match any color of Rod. Each curtain panel contains: Eight (8) stainless metal grommets. Package contains: Two (2) embroidered semi sheer window curtains grommet panels. Care Instructions: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, do not bleach, tumble dry low, light iron as needed.
